title: Training Note — The Interest an Arrangement Carries, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Training Note — The Interest an Arrangement Carries, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

*Basis questions answered for the finance desk.*

**Does an arrangement on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan carry interest?** It depends on how many payments on the plan have been sent back unpaid inside the term's repricing review window.

- Where two or more payments have been sent back unpaid inside that window, the interest is the balance the plan owes after the give-backs booked in the whole month ending on the handling date, taken at the term's penalty rate for one month of a twelve-month year.
- Where exactly one payment has been sent back unpaid inside that window, the interest is that same balance at the term's promotional rate for one month of a twelve-month year.
- In every other case the arrangement carries no interest.

**What balance is it taken on?** The balance the plan record carries, adjusted by the give-backs booked in the whole month ending on the handling date; give-backs are negative, so they bring that balance down.

**What is one month of a twelve-month year?** The annual rate divided by one hundred and then by twelve, applied to that balance, the figure rounded to the cent.

**What are the figures by term?**

| Term | Repricing review window, whole months | Penalty rate | Promotional rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 6 | 32.24 percent | 0 percent |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 6 | 32.24 percent | 0 percent |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 6 | 31.24 percent | 0 percent |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 6 | 30.24 percent | 9.99 percent |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 12 | 29.24 percent | 11.99 percent |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 12 | 27.24 percent | 12.99 percent |

**Worked cases (hypothetical).** A plan on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan carrying a balance of 7,200.00 USD with a give-back of 200.00 USD booked this month, so a balance of 7,000.00 USD:

- With three returns inside the 6 whole months of its review window: 7,000.00 USD at 30.24 percent for one month of a twelve-month year, that is 176.40 USD.
- With exactly one return inside that window: 7,000.00 USD at 9.99 percent for one month of a twelve-month year, that is 58.28 USD.
- With no return inside that window: the arrangement carries no interest.
